description: This file implements interface functions for the PDU Router related to CAN interface indications. Specifically, it contains functions for handling reception indications and transmission confirmations for CAN Protocol Data Units within the AUTOSAR context, under conditional compilation based on configuration macros.

methods.name: void PduR_CanIfRxIndication(PduIdType CanRxPduId,const PduInfoType * PduInfoPtr)
methods.description: Handles the reception indication for a CAN PDU, calls the internal indication handler with specific parameters.

methods.name: void PduR_CanIfTxConfirmation(PduIdType CanTxPduId)
methods.description: Handles the transmission confirmation for a CAN PDU, calls the internal confirmation handler with a dummy variable.
